blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Compositional 3D scene reconstruction enables interactive and editable representations of real-world environments, with applications in robotics, embodied AI, AR/VR, and digital content creation ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yeh et al., 2022 ) . Given a single image of an indoor environment, the goal is to reconstruct an editable, compositional 3D scene that captures its geometry, constituent objects, spatial layout, and lighting ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Yeh et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 构成性3D场景重建能够交互和编辑真实世界环境,在机器人学中应用,体现AI,AR/VR,以及数字内容创建(Ma等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Yeh等人,2022年)。 考虑到室内环境的单一图像,目标是重建一个可编辑的、构成性的三维场景,以捕捉其几何、组成物体、空间布局和照明(Ma等人,2026年;Yeh等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Existing approaches address this problem through several strategies. Procedural and generative methods synthesize diverse 3D environments ( Raistrick et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , while multi-stage reconstruction pipelines divide the task into scene understanding, asset generation, and object placement ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . More recently, code-based agents have represented scenes as executable programs, enabling explicit manipulation of objects and spatial relations ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, reconstructing a specific real-world scene with high fidelity often requires carefully engineered intermediate stages ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Yeh et al., 2022 ) or repeated render-and-refine iterations ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有办法通过若干战略解决这一问题。 程序和基因方法综合了不同的立体环境(Raistrick等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年),而多阶段重建管道将任务分为场景理解,资产生成,以及物体放置(Ma等人,2026年). 最近,基于代码的代理代表了作为可执行程序的场景,从而能够明确操纵物体和空间关系(Yin等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)。 尽管取得了这些进步,重建具有高度忠诚的特定现实世界场景往往需要经过精心设计的中间阶段(马等人,2026年;叶赫等人,2022年)或重复的渲染和反射迭代(殷等人,2026年;黄等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Frontier models such as GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) suggest a more direct approach: generating editable 3D scene programs from a single image with limited iterative refinement. However, their deployment costs motivate us to investigate whether a substantially smaller open-source model can achieve comparable image-to-3D programming capabilities through harness design rather than parameter updates ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026a ) . Our goal is to enable direct scene-code generation while reducing reliance on costly render-and-refine loops.
blocks.zh: 边框模型如GPT-6-Astra(OpenAI,2026b)建议了一个更直接的方法:从一个单一的图像中生成可编辑的3D场景程序,迭代精度有限. 然而,它们的部署费用促使我们调查一个大得多的开源模型是否能够通过利用设计而不是参数更新来实现可比较的图像到3D编程能力(Khattab等人,2024年;Agrawal等人,2026a年)。 我们的目标是实现直接的场景代码生成,同时减少对昂贵的渲染和反射循环的依赖。

blocks.en: Achieving this goal presents two main challenges. First, compact models have limited visual and spatial reasoning capabilities, making it difficult to infer coherent 3D structures and translate visual observations into executable scene representations. Second, effective reconstruction also depends on the external harness: the instructions, tools, and control logic that govern how the model observes, plans, constructs, and executes a scene program ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ) . Addressing these challenges requires both an interface that reduces the demands on geometric reasoning and a reusable procedure that guides reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 实现这一目标提出了两大挑战。 首先,紧凑模型的视觉和空间推理能力有限,难以推断出连贯的3D结构,将视觉观测转化为可执行的场景表现. 第二,有效重建还取决于外部的利用:指导模型如何观察、规划、构建和执行场景程序的指示、工具和控制逻辑(Yin等人,2026年;Khattab等人,2024年)。 应对这些挑战既需要减少几何推理需求的接口,也需要指导重建的可重复使用的程序。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce SceneEvolve , as shown in Figure 1 , a framework that combines a compositional scene interface, SceneAct , with a teacher-guided harness evolution framework, SceneHarness-RSI . SceneAct translates high-level scene intent into executable operations through parameterized geometric primitives, hierarchical object composition, and semantic spatial relations. These abstractions reduce the need for low-level geometric programming while preserving explicit scene structure. Building on this interface, SceneHarness-RSI uses a stronger teacher model to analyze the frozen student’s development-set reconstructions, execution traces, and evaluation feedback, then propose revisions to the shared reconstruction harness. Candidate harnesses are evaluated under a common execution budget, and revisions are retained when they improve the development score. Throughout this process, the student parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The optimization target is the reusable reconstruction procedure, which is subsequently frozen and deployed on unseen scenes without teacher assistance.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了SceneEvolve,如图1所示,这个框架结合了构成场景界面SceneAct , 并配有教师引导的拉带演化框架SceneHarness-RSI. SceneAct通过参数化几何原始,等级对象组成,以及语义空间关系,将高级场景意向转化为可执行操作. 这些抽象物减少了低级几何编程的需要,同时保留了明显的场景结构. 在这种界面的基础上,SceneHarness-RSI使用更强大的教师模式来分析被冻结的学生的发展设置重建,执行痕迹,以及评价反馈,然后对共享的重建工具提出修改建议. 在共同执行预算下评价候选人的利用情况,并在提高发展分数时保留订正。 在整个过程中,学生参数,动作语义,以及执行后端仍然固定. 优化的目标是可重复使用的重建程序,随后在没有教师协助的情况下被冻结并部署在看不见的场景上.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We formulate compositional 3D scene reconstruction as an executable harness-optimization problem, targeting direct code generation without parameter updates or repeated iterations. • We introduce SceneAct , a compositional interface that maps scene intent to executable 3D scene code using parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, providing explicit control over object geometry and scene structure. • We propose SceneHarness-RSI , a teacher-guided recursive evolution method for optimizing reusable reconstruction harnesses. Teacher guidance is used only during evolution, allowing the resulting harnesses to generalize to unseen scenes without teacher assistance. • Across in-domain and out-of-domain datasets, SceneEvolve with Qwen3.8-27B outperforms GPT-5.6-Sol , reducing cost by 59.8% and inference time by 47.0% relative to the baseline. The evolved harness also transfers to Kimi-K3, achieving results competitive with GPT-6-Astra and demonstrating its transferability across different backbone models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Single-image reconstruction and generative models recover object geometry and appearance ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) , while scene-level methods model object layouts and relations using semantic priors ( Lin & Mu, 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) or jointly predict multiple objects and their spatial configurations ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . SceneAct unifies object construction and scene composition in an executable program with primitives and spatial operators.
blocks.zh: 单象重建与基因模型恢复物体几何和外观(Hong等人,2024年;徐等人,2024年;Xiang等人,2025年),而场景层次方法模型则使用语义前缀(Lin & Mu,2024年;Lin等人,2025年)或联合预测多个物体及其空间布局(Huang等人,2025年;Meng等人,2026年). 场景法案将对象构造和场景构成统一在一个具有原始人和空间操作员的可执行程序中.

blocks.en: Compositional reconstruction represents object geometry and scene layout as separately editable components. Prior work aligns CAD models or jointly estimates layout, poses, and geometry ( Izadinia et al., 2017 ; Nie et al., 2020 ) , with inverse rendering further recovering materials and lighting ( Yeh et al., 2022 ) . Recent methods combine single-image scene analysis, object generation, and spatial refinement ( Ardelean et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , leverage multi-view evidence for assembly ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Qin et al., 2026 ) , or jointly generate object geometry and spatial configurations ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . SceneEvolve instead realizes object-centric reconstruction as an executable scene program built from parameterized primitives, part hierarchies, and spatial relations, enabling a frozen agent to construct and edit the scene.
blocks.zh: 组成重建代表对象几何和场景布局作为可单独编辑的组件. 先前的工作将CAD模型或共同估计布局、布局和几何学相配合(Izadinia等人,2017年;Nie等人,2020年),反向渲染进一步恢复材料和照明(Yeh等人,2022年)。 近代方法结合了单像场景分析,物体生成,空间精细化(Ardelean等人,2025年;Ma等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b),利用多景证据进行组装(霞等人,2026年;秦等人,2026年),或联合生成物体几何和空间配置(黄等人,2025年;孟等人,2026年). 相反,SceneEvolve实现了以对象为中心的重建,作为可执行的场景程序,由参数化的原始,部分等级,以及空间关系所构建,使得一个被冻结的代理能够构造和编辑场景.

blocks.en: Procedural and language-guided generators use reusable assets and spatial constraints for controllable scene synthesis ( Deitke et al., 2022 ; Raistrick et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Related representations encode hierarchical assemblies as executable programs ( Jones et al., 2020 ) or predict structured scene descriptions from visual or point-cloud observations ( Avetisyan et al., 2024 ; Mao et al., 2025 ) . Visual coding agents further generate and refine graphics programs through rendered feedback, reusable libraries, and execution-guided iteration ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . SceneAct exposes a fixed set of semantic construction operators, while SceneHarness-RSI optimizes the reusable procedure.
blocks.zh: 程序和语言制导发电机利用可重复使用的资产和空间限制进行可控场景合成(Deitke等人,2022年;Raistrick等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年)。 相关表述将分级集合编码为可执行程序(Jones等人,2020年)或从视觉或点云观测预测结构化场景描述(Avetisyan等人,2024年;Mao等人,2025年). 视觉编码代理商通过提供反馈、可重复使用的库和执行制导的迭代,进一步生成和完善图形程序(Hu等人,2024年;Huang等人,2024年)。 2024; 殷等, 2026; 杨等, 2026; 王等, 2026. blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: We propose SceneEvolve , a framework for compositional image-to-3D reconstruction of indoor scenes, as illustrated in Figure 2 . The framework comprises two components: SceneAct , a compact semantic interface that maps high-level scene intent to executable actions, and SceneHarness-RSI , a teacher-guided procedure that ens the reconstruction harness using end-to-end reconstruction feedback. SceneAct defines the executable interface through which the frozen student agent reconstructs 3D scenes. SceneHarness-RSI iteratively refines the harness through a propose–execute–evaluate–retain cycle to improve how the student uses SceneAct while keeping the student parameters fixed.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们提议将室内场景的成像到3D重建框架“场景演变”。 该框架由两个部分组成:Scene Act 和SceneHarness-RSI(教师指导程序,利用端到端的重建反馈将重建利用),后者是一个紧凑的语义界面,它描绘了高层次场景执行行动的意图。 SceneAct定义了被冻结的学生代理通过它重建3D场景的可执行界面. SceneHarness-RSI通过一个提议-执行-评价-保留周期来迭代地精炼这种牵引力,以改善学生在保持学生参数固定的同时如何使用Scene Act.

blocks.en: 3.2 SceneAct: A Compact Semantic Interface from Intent to Actions
blocks.zh: 3.2 场景法:从意向到行动的压缩语义界面

blocks.en: SceneAct provides a compact semantic interface between high-level scene reasoning and low-level Blender execution. It enables the student agent to use semantically meaningful actions that are deterministically translated into executable Blender operations, reducing the need to directly specify low-level geometric operations and numerical parameters. The action space comprises three complementary abstractions: composable parameterized primitives , hierarchical composition , and semantic spatial relations . Together, these abstractions support progressive scene construction from local geometry to object structure and scene-level layout.
blocks.zh: SceneAct提供了高级场景推理和低级Blender执行之间的紧凑语义界面. 它使学生代理能够使用可决定性地转化为可执行的Blender操作的有目的的行动,从而减少了直接指定低级几何操作和数值参数的需要. 动作空间包括三个互补的抽象:可混合参数化原始物,等级构成,和语义空间关系. 这些抽象元素共同支持从局部几何到对象结构和场景层布局的渐进场景构造.

A SceneAct program can instantiate multiple primitives, with each primitive ρ i \rho_{i} represented as ρ i = ( κ i , 𝐠 i , 𝐚 i ) , κ i ∈ 𝒢 , \rho_{i}=\bigl(\kappa_{i},\mathbf{g}_{i},\mathbf{a}_{i}\bigr),\qquad\kappa_{i}\in\mathcal{G}, (1) where κ i \kappa_{i} identifies a primitive class in the predefined library 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , and 𝐠 i \mathbf{g}_{i} and 𝐚 i \mathbf{a}_{i} denote its geometric and appearance parameters, respectively. This representation allows the student agent to construct geometry by instantiating and configuring primitive classes without directly manipulating mesh vertices, faces, or other low-level Blender representations.

blocks.en: The primitive classes share a common interface for translation, rotation, and scaling, allowing their instances to be composed into higher-level scene structures. For example, a tabletop can be represented by a thin Box , its supporting legs by Box or Cylinder instances, and a curved lamp arm by a Curve . These primitives can then be transformed and assembled into semantic parts and assets. This design expresses reconstruction as a sequence of compact, executable decisions and shifts the student’s reasoning from low-level mesh programming to structured geometric construction. In this way, the student’s geometric reasoning is reduced to two interpretable decisions: which primitive best explains each visible part, and what geometric and appearance parameters characterize it?
blocks.zh: 原始类共用一个翻译,旋转,和缩放的通用界面,可以将其实例组成更高层次的场景结构. 例如,一个表顶可以用一个薄薄的盒子来表示,它的支撑腿可以用Box或圆柱实例来表示,一个弯曲的灯臂可以用曲线来表示. 这些原始物随后可以被转化和组装成语义部件和资产. 这种设计表示重建是一系列紧凑,可执行的决定,并将学生的推理从低层网格编程转向结构化几何构造. 这样一来,学生的几何推理被简化为两个可解释的决定:哪个原始最能解释每个可见部分,以及什么几何和外观参数是它的特点?

blocks.en: We organize the reconstructed scene using an explicit semantic hierarchy implemented in the scene program. The Scene class manages a collection of assets through interfaces such as scene.add_asset(…) . The reusable Asset base class encapsulates object-level structure and provides asset.add_part(…) for composing semantic parts. Each Part is constructed from one or more parameterized geometric primitives. This hierarchy separates scene-level composition, object-level structure, and part-level geometry: the Scene supports adding, removing, transforming, and duplicating complete assets, while each Asset controls the construction and refinement of its internal parts. For example, a table asset may contain a tabletop and several legs, each constructed independently from geometric primitives. This program structure supports modular construction and localized editing while preserving a direct correspondence between visually identifiable entities in the input image and their executable representations.
blocks.zh: 我们组织重建的场景 使用一个明确的语义层次 执行在现场程序。 场景类通过场景等接口管理集合资产.add_asset(...). 可重复使用的资产基类封装对象级结构,并提供资产.add_part(...)用于组合语义部分. 每个 部分由一个或多个参数化的几何原始构造. 这种等级将场景层组成,对象层结构,和部分层几何区分:场景支持添加,移除,转化,复制完整的资产,而每个资产则控制其内部部分的构造和完善. 例如,一个表格资产可能包含一个表顶和几个腿,每个腿都独立于几何原始物. 这个程序结构支持模块化构建和本地化编辑,同时保留了可视化可识别实体在输入图像中与其可执行表现之间的直接对应.

blocks.en: SceneAct specifies spatial structure through semantic relations, reducing the need to predict explicit coordinates. This design is motivated by the observation that VLMs are more reliable at inferring relations such as under , attached to , and facing than at predicting the precise 3D translations and rotations needed to realize them. Accordingly, each scene element exposes geometric features with semantic meaning, including center , extent , support , anchor , and boundary , together with relational operators such as align(…) and distribute(…) .
blocks.zh: 场景法通过语义关系来指定空间结构,减少了预测明确坐标的需要. 这种设计的动机是,人们观察到VLM在推断诸如under,附着,以及面对的关系时比预测实现这些关系所需的精确的3D翻译和旋转更为可靠. 因此,每个场景元素都暴露出具有语义意义的几何特征,包括中心,范围,支持,锚定,和边界等,以及对齐(.)和分布(.)等关系运算符. 。 。 。

blocks.en: These operators encode spatial constraints relative to scene geometry. For example, four table legs can be positioned below a tabletop and aligned with its corners without predicting their coordinates independently. The SceneAct interpreter resolves such relations into deterministic transformations based on current geometry, reference frames, extents, and anchors. Since the constraints are defined structurally rather than in fixed world coordinates, they can be re-evaluated after edits, allowing dependent elements to update automatically. This separates relational reasoning from numerical transformation computation, reducing direct coordinate prediction while preserving precision.
blocks.zh: 这些操作员将空间约束与场景几何相对编码. 例如,四个表脚可以放在一个表顶下面,并与其角对齐,而不独立预测它们的坐标. SceneAct解释器根据目前的几何,参考框架,范围,以及锚定,将这种关系解决成决定性的转变. 由于限制在结构上而不是在固定的世界坐标中被定义,在编辑后可以重新评价,允许依赖元素自动更新. 这将关系推理与数值转换计算区分开来,减少直接坐标预测,同时保持精度.

blocks.en: 3.3 SceneHarness-RSI : A teacher-guided recursive harness evolution
blocks.zh: 3.3 场景Harness-RSI:由教师指导的递归式拉带演化

blocks.en: SceneHarness-RSI improves the execution harness of a frozen student through teacher-guided revisions. Starting from an initial harness H 0 H_{0} , the student reconstructs development-set scenes through SceneAct , producing Blender programs, rendered outputs, and execution traces. A teacher uses this evidence to identify limitations of the current harness and propose targeted revisions. The same frozen student then evaluates the revised harnesses under a fixed protocol, and only revisions that improve the recorded development-set reconstruction score are retained. Repeating this propose–execute–evaluate–retain cycle defines an outer-loop search over executable harnesses.

SceneHarness-RSI searches over revisions to these components while keeping the SceneAct semantics, student parameters, and Blender execution backend fixed.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use three indoor scene datasets comprising 160 scenes in total: ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) for in-domain development and evaluation, and ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) for out-of-domain evaluation. The resulting split consists of 100 development scenes, 40 in-domain test scenes, and 20 out-of-domain test scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个室内场景数据集,共计160幕: ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年)和CA-1M(Lazarow等人,2025年)用于域内开发和评价,ARKitScenes(Baruch等人,2021年)用于域外评估. 由此产生的分裂包括100个开发场景,40个域内测试场景,20个域外测试场景.

blocks.en: ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) provides RGB-D sequences with camera poses, reconstructed indoor geometry, and semantic annotations, while CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) contains handheld egocentric captures registered to high-quality laser scans with dense 3D object annotations. From each dataset, we randomly sample 70 scenes and partition them at the scene level into disjoint development and test sets of 50 and 20 scenes, respectively. All views and repeated captures of the same physical scene are confined to a single split. The development sets are used for recursive harness search, while the test sets are reserved exclusively for in-domain evaluation.
blocks.zh: ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年)为RGB-D序列提供了相机姿势,重建室内几何,语义说明,而CA-1M(Lazarow等人,2025年)则包含了手持的自我中心俘获,登记在高品质的激光扫描上,带有密集的3D物体说明. 从每个数据集中,我们随机抽取了70个场景,并在场景一级将它们分为分别由50个场景和20个场景组成的脱节开发和测试组. 所有观点和对同一物理场景的反复捕捉都局限于一个分裂. 开发套件用于递归带搜索,而测试套件则专门用于域内评价.

blocks.en: ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) contains mobile RGB-D indoor captures with laser-scanned geometry and 3D object annotations. We randomly sample 20 scenes for out-of-domain evaluation. The harness developed on ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) is transferred directly to these scenes with the student weights, harness code, and inference configuration fixed. No ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) data or feedback are used during harness development, enabling a clean evaluation of cross-dataset generalization.
blocks.zh: ARKitScenes(Baruch等人,2021年)包含移动的RGB-D室内捕捉器,带有激光扫描几何和3D物体说明. 我们随机抽取20个场景进行域外评价. 在ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年)和CA-1M(Lazarow等人,2025年)上开发的牵引装置被直接转移到这些场景,并固定了学生的重量,牵引码和推论配置. 没有ARKitScenes(Baruch等人,2021年)数据或反馈在利用开发过程中使用,从而能够对跨数据集的泛化进行干净的评价.

blocks.en: We evaluate all methods along three dimensions: reconstruction quality, inference efficiency, and equivalent cost. Reconstruction quality is measured by PSNR ( Wang & Bovik, 2009 ) , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and DINOv2 similarity ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , capturing pixel, structural, perceptual, and semantic fidelity, respectively. Inference efficiency is measured by the average per-scene inference time under a unified protocol. We further report the average equivalent cost per scene under a consistent cost definition, enabling direct comparison of the trade-offs among quality, efficiency, and cost across model configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个方面评估所有方法:重建质量、推论效率和同等费用。 重建质量由PSNR(Wang & Bovik,2009年),SSIM(Wang等人,2004年),LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)和DINOv2相似度(Oquab等人,2024年)测量,分别捕捉像素,结构,知觉和语义忠诚度. 推论效率以统一协议下的每层平均推论时间来衡量. 我们还在一个一致的成本定义下报告每个场景的平均等价成本,以便能够直接比较不同模型配置在质量、效率和成本之间的权衡。

blocks.en: We benchmark proprietary multimodal models as zero-shot agents for compositional image-to-3D scene reconstruction, without task-specific fine-tuning. Our baseline suite includes GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) and GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , and Gemini-Flash-3.8 ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . For models with configurable reasoning effort, we evaluate all supported settings among none , low , medium , and high , treating each model–effort pair as a distinct baseline configuration. We also evaluate Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) at xhigh , using the same model and reasoning configuration as the frozen student in our method. We additionally use Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) at high as a cross-model validation harness.
blocks.zh: 我们把专有的多模式模型作为零镜头剂,用于构象到3D场景重建,不进行特定任务微调. 我们的基线套房包括GPT-5.6-Sol(OpenAI,2026a)和GPT-6-Astra(OpenAI,2026b),克劳德-奥普斯-5(Anthropic,2026)和双子座-Flash-3.8(Google DeepMind,2026). 对于具有可配置推理功能的模型,我们对所有支持的设置进行零、低、中、高的评价,将每个模型 — — 效果配对 — — 视为一个独特的基线配置。 我们还在xhigh评价Qwen3.8-27B(Quen Team, 2026 ),使用与我们方法中冷冻学生相同的模型和推理配置. 我们还高处使用Kimi-K3(Kimi Team,2026年)作为跨型号验证机.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) at xhigh as the frozen student and GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) at medium as the harness proposer, running K = 30 K=30 rounds with M = 2 M=2 proposals each. Candidates are conditioned on archived development evidence and evaluated on equally weighted ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) scenes, with input frames selected by a space-aware frame sampling strategy following Spatial-MLLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . The selected harness and inference configuration are frozen at test. All models are accessed exclusively via API calls, without using additional third-party harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code, or pi. To evaluate the cross-model transferability of the self-evolved harness, we apply the harness evolved with Qwen3.8-27B directly to Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) at high .

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 量化结果

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Comparison with the Base Model
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 与基准模型的比较

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , SceneEvolve consistently outperforms Qwen3.8-27B across all four reconstruction metrics and three datasets under fixed student weights and reasoning effort. Averaged across datasets, DINOv2-S increases from 0.198 to 0.392, while SSIM improves by 6.7%, LPIPS decreases by 6.1%, and PSNR increases by 0.118 dB; these gains also transfer to the unseen ARKitScenes dataset without target-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,SceneEvolve在所有四个重建指标和三个数据集中,在固定学生权重和推理努力下的业绩一直高于Qune3.8-27B。 平均跨数据集,DINOv2-S从0.198增长到0.392,而SSIM则改善6.7%,LPIPS下降6.1%,PSNR增加0.118 dB;这些增益也转移到看不见的ARKitScenes数据集而无需针对特定目标进行调整.

blocks.en: As Figure 4 and Figure 5 illustrate, SceneEvolve reduces mean per-scene inference time by 37.5% on ScanNet, 55.1% on CA-1M, and 46.8% on ARKitScenes relative to the base Qwen3.8-27B xhigh . Across the three datasets, mean inference time decreases from 1,510.7 to 800.2 seconds, a reduction of 47.0%, alongside improvements in all four reconstruction metrics.
blocks.zh: 如图4和图5所示,SceneEvolve在ScanNet上将平均每个场景的推断时间减少37.5%,在CA-1M上减少55.1%,在ARKitScenes上比基数Qwen3.8-27Bxhigh减少46.8%. 在三个数据集中,平均推断时间从1,510.7秒减少到800.2秒,减少了47.0%,同时改进了所有四个重建指标。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 4 and Figure 5 , SceneEvolve achieves lower deployment costs across datasets, reducing the mean equivalent deployment cost by 20.5% relative to the Qwen3.8-27B xHigh baseline and by 22.7% on both ScanNet and CA-1M. Overall, SceneEvolve provides a more favorable trade-off between reconstruction quality, inference time, and cost.

blocks.en: To evaluate the cross-model generalizability of harness evolution, we directly transfer the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B to Kimi-K3 under the high reasoning-effort setting, without any target-specific search, fine-tuning, or manual adaptation. As shown in Table 1 , the transferred harness consistently improves all four reconstruction metrics across all three datasets compared with the Kimi-K3 baseline without the transferred harness. These results demonstrate that harness evolution can discover reconstruction strategies that generalize beyond the model used during the search, rather than merely exploiting model-specific behaviors.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Comparison with Frontier Models
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 与边疆模式的比较

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-27B with SceneEvolve outperforms GPT-5.6-Sol with none reasoning effort in eleven of twelve dataset–metric comparisons, improving mean SSIM by 32.3%, reducing LPIPS by 3.4%, increasing PSNR by 1.155 dB and increasing its DINOv2-S by 6.3%. All four metrics improve on CA-1M and ARKitScenes. Mean SSIM also exceeds Sol-low, Sol-medium, and Sol-high by 32.5%, 26.3%, and 20.0%, respectively. Against Astra-low and Astra-medium, mean SSIM improves by 9.6% and 7.3%, respectively.

Compared with the base, Qwen3.8-27B with SceneEvolve improves scene coherence, particularly in the bar and lounge, correcting severe viewpoint distortions and better recovering furniture arrangements. It also aligns wooden seats with the bar counter and preserves the lounge’s dark green accent wall and furniture arrangement. Compared with frontier models, it matches GPT-6-Astra’s counter-side seating and booth composition while avoiding the extra furniture rows in GPT-5.6-Sol and better preserving tabletop proportions. Notably, its lounge reconstruction retains the dark green wall more distinctly than either frontier model. blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate SceneAct and SceneHarness-RSI with Qwen3.8-27B at xhigh . w/o SceneAct replaces SceneAct with direct Blender operations under the same optimization budget, while w/o SceneHarness-RSI keeps SceneAct but uses the initial, unevolved harness. The full method combines both.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , incorporating SceneAct increases DINOv2-S from 0.305 to 0.392 and reduces mean inference time by 22.7% compared with the w/o SceneAct variant. These results suggest that the structured interface, which supports hierarchical construction and semantic placement, improves both reconstruction quality and inference efficiency.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , with SceneAct fixed, harness evolution increases DINOv2-S from 0.285 to 0.392, reduces mean inference time by 43.8%, and lowers the mean equivalent cost per scene from $0.155 to $0.117. These results support the value of optimizing a reusable reconstruction procedure alongside the structured action interface.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SceneEvolve , a framework for editable, compositional 3D scene reconstruction in code-generated scene settings that combines a structured scene action interface SceneAct with teacher-guided evolution of a reusable reconstruction harness SceneHarness-RSI . Extensive experiments demonstrate that SceneEvolve improves over its base configuration and outperforms GPT-5.6-Sol with none reasoning effort, while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% and equivalent deployment cost per scene by 59.8%. Furthermore, a reconstruction harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B can also generalize to different models like Kimi-K3, achieving reconstruction results competitive with those of GPT-6-Astra.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 SceneEvolve, 一个可编辑的框架, 构成 3D 场景重建 在代码生成的场景设置中, 广泛的实验表明,SceneEvolve在基础配置上有所改进,并且超过了GPT-5.6-Sol,没有推理努力,同时将平均推断时间减少了47.0%,每个场景的等效部署成本减少了59.8%. 此外,使用Qune3.8-27B发展起来的重建装置还可以概括到Kimi-K3等不同模式,实现与GPT-6-Astra相比的重建成果。

blocks.en: A.1 Dataset Details
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集细节

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of SceneEvolve , we conduct experiments on three representative indoor-scene datasets covering different capture settings: ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) , CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) , and ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) . ScanNet and CA-1M serve as in-domain datasets for harness development and evaluation, while ARKitScenes is reserved for out-of-domain evaluation. We use 160 scenes in total, comprising 100 development scenes, 40 in-domain test scenes, and 20 out-of-domain test scenes. All methods are evaluated on the same held-out scenes under a consistent single-image reconstruction protocol. Input views are selected using a space-aware frame sampling strategy following Spatial-MLLM ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . For each in-domain dataset, all views and repeated captures of the same physical scene are kept within a single split to prevent development–test overlap. Detailed descriptions are provided below.
blocks.zh: 为了评价SceneEvolve的有效性,我们进行了三个具有代表性的室内场景数据集的实验,涵盖不同的捕获环境: ScanNet(Dai等人,2017年),CA-1M(Lazarow等人,2025年)和ARKitScenes(Baruch等人,2021年). ScanNet和CA-1M作为利用开发和评价的域内数据集,而ARKitScens则保留用于域外评价. 我们总共使用了160个场景,包括100个开发场景,40个域内测试场景,20个域外测试场景. 根据一致的单一图像重建协议,所有方法都在同一被搁置的场景上进行评估。 使用空间-MLLM之后的空间认识框架取样战略选择输入视图(Wu等人,2025年)。 对于每个域内数据集,对同一个物理场景的所有视图和重复捕捉被保存在一个单一的分割内,以防止开发–测试重叠. 详细说明如下。

blocks.en: • ScanNet. ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) provides RGB-D sequences of indoor environments with camera poses, reconstructed 3D geometry, and semantic annotations. We randomly sample 70 scenes and divide them into 50 development scenes and 20 held-out in-domain test scenes. Its indoor layouts and object arrangements make it suitable for assessing whether a reconstruction agent can recover coherent scene geometry, constituent objects, and spatial relationships from a single image. The development split supplies reconstruction feedback for harness evolution, whereas the test split is used exclusively for evaluation. • CA-1M. CA-1M ( Lazarow et al., 2025 ) contains handheld egocentric indoor captures registered to high-quality laser scans, together with dense 3D object annotations. We randomly sample 70 scenes, assigning 50 to harness development and 20 to held-out in-domain evaluation. Compared with ScanNet, its capture and annotation setting provides a complementary test of object-level geometry, relative proportions, and spatial composition. As with ScanNet, only the development scenes are used to evaluate candidate harness revisions; the held-out test scenes are not used during harness search. • ARKitScenes. ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) consists of mobile RGB-D captures of indoor environments with laser-scanned geometry and 3D object annotations. We randomly sample 20 scenes and use them exclusively for out-of-domain evaluation. Unlike the two in-domain datasets, ARKitScenes contributes no images or reconstruction feedback to harness development. The student parameters, selected harness, and inference configuration are transferred without modification, making this benchmark a test of whether the reconstruction procedure generalizes to previously unseen data.

blocks.en: A.2 Counterpart Details
blocks.zh: A.2 对应方详情

blocks.en: This section provides a detailed overview of the counterpart models employed in our experiments. We compare SceneEvolve with the unmodified student backbone and representative proprietary multimodal models, including GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-6-Astra, Claude-Opus-5, and Gemini-Flash-3.8. The proprietary models are evaluated as zero-shot agents for compositional image-to-3D scene reconstruction without task-specific fine-tuning. For models supporting configurable reasoning effort, each model–effort combination is treated as a separate counterpart. All counterparts are evaluated on the same held-out scenes using consistent reconstruction metrics. Details are provided below.
blocks.zh: 本节详细概述了我们实验中使用的对应模型。 我们比较SceneEvolve与未修改的学生骨干和代表性的专有型多式联运模型,包括GPT-5.6-Sol,GPT-6-Astra,Claude-Opus-5,和双子座-Flash-3.8. 专有模型被评价为零镜头剂,用于组装成像到-3D场景重建,而不进行任务特定的微调. 对于支持可配置推理努力的模型,每个模型-努力组合被作为单独的对应物处理. 对所有对应方都采用一致的重建衡量标准,对相同的场景进行评价。 详情如下。

blocks.en: • Qwen3.8-27B. Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) serves as the open-source backbone and the primary base-model counterpart. We evaluate it at xhigh reasoning effort, matching the model and inference effort used by the frozen student in SceneEvolve . This comparison isolates the improvements obtained from the proposed reconstruction framework without changing the underlying student model parameters. • Kimi-K3. Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) is an open-weight multimodal model evaluated at high reasoning effort to investigate the cross-model generalization of the evolved harness. Specifically, we directly transfer the harness evolved with Qwen3.8-27B to Kimi-K3 without additional harness evolution, model fine-tuning, or target-model-specific optimization. blocks.en: B.1 Self-improving agents and harness optimization
blocks.zh: B.1 自我改进剂和优化利用

blocks.en: Self-improving agent systems leverage feedback from prior executions to iteratively refine the mechanisms that govern subsequent behavior. Existing approaches differ primarily in the components they optimize and the forms of feedback they exploit. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) records natural-language reflections in episodic memory to inform future decisions, whereas STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) recursively improves an executable scaffold. A complementary line of work, including TextGrad ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ) , ProTeGi ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) , GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026b ) , and Feedback Descent ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , optimizes textual components using natural-language feedback. More recently, Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) and Self-Harness ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) extend the optimization target to agent source code, using execution outcomes to guide iterative code revisions. Their evaluations span diverse tasks: Meta-Harness considers classification, mathematical reasoning, and terminal-based coding, while Self-Harness evaluates performance on Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, and AppWorld. Although these methods differ in their optimization targets and feedback mechanisms, they share a common objective: improving agent performance through iterative system-level refinement rather than relying exclusively on conventional model training. SceneEvolve extends this line of research to code-based 3D scene reconstruction, where agent performance depends not only on the underlying model but also on the execution logic that translates reconstruction objectives into executable code and rendered scenes.
blocks.zh: 自我改进的代理系统利用先前处决的反馈,反复完善管理随后行为的机制。 现有方法主要在它们优化的组成部分和它们利用的反馈形式上有所不同。 Reflexion (Shinn et al., 2023)记录了史诗记忆中的自然语言反射,为将来的决定提供参考,而STOP(Zelikman et al., 2024)则不断改进可执行脚手架. 包括TextGrad(Yukekgonul等人,2025年),ProTeGi(Pryzant等人,2023年),GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026年b),以及RefensiveGeorgen(Lee等人,2025年b)在内的互补工作,利用自然语言反馈优化了文本组件. 最近,Meta-Harness(Lee等人,2026年)和Self-Harness(Zhang等人,2026a年)将优化目标扩展至代理源代码,利用执行结果指导迭代代码的修订. 它们的评价涉及各种任务: Meta-Harness考虑分类,数学推理,和基于终端的编码,而Self-Harness则在Terminal-Bench,SWE-bench,AppWorld上评价性能. 虽然这些方法在优化目标和反馈机制上有所不同,但它们有一个共同的目标:通过迭代系统层面的完善,而不是完全依赖传统的模式培训来提高代理业绩。 SceneEvolve将这一研究线延伸至基于代码的3D场景重建,其中代理性能不仅依赖于基础模型,还依赖于将重建目标转化为可执行代码并渲染场景的执行逻辑.

blocks.en: D.1 Initial harness

blocks.en: We use a minimal initial harness as the shared baseline for all models in our benchmark. For baseline evaluation, every model is assessed under the same harness and prompt protocol to ensure comparability. Each example is processed through a direct model call only; we do not use external coding-agent harnesses or frameworks such as Codex, Claude Code, or Pi. The harness consists exclusively of the system prompt and the user prompt shown below. It does not include MCP tools, skills, an agent-loop architecture, memory, or other external tool-use or orchestration components. For each example, the model receives a single textual prompt together with the reference image and is expected to return a complete, executable Blender Python program. As specified in the system prompt, file saving and rendering are handled by a separate local evaluation script rather than by an agent framework. The exact prompts used in this baseline are provided below.

Accurately recreate the scene using actual 3D geometry, materials, lighting, and a camera. Do not use the input image as a background or substitute for 3D modeling. Explicitly set the active scene camera. Handle scene modeling and configuration only. Do not save files or render the scene, as these operations will be handled by a separate local script.

blocks.en: D.2 The evolved final harness
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 进化的终极绳

blocks.en: Planning Stage. Given the reference image and reconstruction instruction, the harness first analyzes the scene to identify visible architectural structures, furniture, and object instances, estimating their geometry, proportions, appearance, camera viewpoint, and key spatial relationships, including relative positioning and occlusion. Based on this analysis, it constructs a hierarchical scene plan that organizes the scene into individual assets and their constituent parts, while specifying relevant object attributes, spatial configurations, and inter-object relationships. The resulting plan is then serialized into a structured JSON document that serves as a machine-readable intermediate representation for downstream code generation. By explicitly encoding the scene hierarchy, object properties, and spatial constraints, this document provides a clear and consistent specification for the subsequent code generation stage. Throughout the planning process, the harness grounds its decisions in visible evidence, treating uncertain or occluded regions conservatively and avoiding unsupported assumptions.
blocks.zh: 规划阶段。 鉴于参考图像和重建指示,该工具首先分析场景,以识别可见的建筑结构、家具和物体实例,估计其几何、比例、外观、摄像头和关键空间关系,包括相对定位和隔离。 基于这一分析,它构建了一个分级场景计划,将场景组织为单个资产及其组成部分,同时明确相关的物体属性,空间配置,以及对象间关系. 由此产生的计划随后被串联成结构化的JSON文件,作为下游代码生成的机器可读中间代表. 通过明确编码场景等级,对象属性,和空间约束,本文件为随后的代码生成阶段提供了清晰一致的规格. 在整个规划过程中,这种利用以明显的证据作为其决定的依据,保守地对待不确定或被占据的区域,并避免无根据的假设。

blocks.en: Code Executing Stage. The coding agent translates the scene plan into executable Blender Python through SceneAct interface. Parameterized primitives represent local geometry, the asset–part hierarchy captures object structure, and semantic spatial operators express relations such as alignment, distribution, support, and attachment. The harness encourages the agent to construct objects compositionally, reuse consistent reference frames, and specify the camera, materials, colors, and lighting explicitly. This organization reduces reliance on independently guessed low-level coordinates and makes it possible to localize later edits to particular objects or parts.
blocks.zh: 代码执行阶段 。 编码代理通过SceneAct接口将场景计划翻译为可执行的Blender Python. 参数化原始物代表了局部几何,资产 - part 的阶梯捕捉对象结构,语义空间操作者表达对齐,分布,支持,附加等关系. 该装置鼓励剂在构件上构建物体、再利用一致的参照框架,并明确规定相机、材料、颜色和照明。 这个组织减少了对独立猜测的低层坐标的依赖,并使得以后编辑到特定对象或部分的地方化成为可能.

blocks.en: Inspect and Render Feedback. The harness evaluates the generated scene through iterative execution, rendering, and inspection. After executing the Blender script, the harness first checks for syntax errors, runtime failures, and other execution issues. If the script runs successfully, the resulting scene is rendered from the target camera viewpoint and inspected against the reference image and the structured scene plan. The inspection combines visual assessment with spatial validation: a vision-language model evaluates global composition, camera framing, object appearance, materials, colors, lighting, and occlusion patterns, while spatial checks examine object dimensions, relative positions, alignment, support, attachment, and unintended intersections where applicable. Based on the identified issues, the harness generates targeted repair instructions associated with specific objects, parts, or scene attributes, allowing the coding agent to modify the relevant portions of the Blender code rather than regenerate the entire scene. The updated code is then executed and rendered again, forming an iterative feedback loop in which each revision is evaluated against the reference and the original scene plan. By grounding code revisions in both rendered evidence and explicit spatial constraints, this stage improves visual fidelity and structural consistency while reducing unnecessary modifications to components that already satisfy the reconstruction requirements.
blocks.zh: 检查和辐射反馈。 吊带通过迭代执行,渲染和检查来评价生成的场景. 执行Blender脚本后,使用首先检查语法错误,运行时间失败,以及其他执行问题. 如果脚本运行成功,由此产生的场景会从目标镜头角度进行渲染,并对照参考图像和结构化场景计划进行检查. 检查将视觉评估与空间验证结合起来:一个视觉语言模型评价全球构成、照相机框架、物体外观、材料、颜色、照明和隔离模式,而空间检查则酌情审查物体尺寸、相对位置、对齐、支持、附件和意外交叉。 根据已查明的问题,这种牵引装置产生与特定物体、部件或场景属性有关的有针对性的修理指示,使编码代理能够修改Blender代码的相关部分,而不是重新生成整个场景。 更新后的代码随后被执行并再次渲染,形成一个迭代反馈循环,其中每个修订都根据参考和原场景计划进行评估. 通过在证据和明确空间限制两方面对代码进行基础修订,这一阶段提高了视觉的忠诚度和结构一致性,同时减少了对已经满足重建要求的部件的不必要的修改。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: SceneEvolve provides an effective approach to harness optimization, while leaving room for further improvement. First, harness evolution incurs substantial computational costs due to repeated teacher-guided analysis, candidate generation, scene reconstruction, rendering, and evaluation, highlighting a trade-off between harness quality and search efficiency. Second, harness optimization improves task execution but does not directly enhance the underlying model’s capabilities, and the evolved system does not consistently outperform strong models such as GPT-6-Astra. Future work could jointly evolve RSI harnesses and adapt RSI models to improve reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 场景演进提供了利用优化的有效方法,同时为进一步改进留有余地. 第一,由于一再进行教师指导分析、候选人生成、场景重建、渲染和评价,并突出利用质量与搜索效率之间的权衡,利用演变需要大量计算费用。 第二,利用优化可以改善任务执行,但不能直接增强基础模型的能力,而进化的系统也不能一贯地超过GPT-6-Astra等强大的模型. 今后的工作可以共同发展RSI利用和调整RSI模式,以提高重建质量。
